workspace.reviewNotCommitted: Review does not save the order.

workspace.reviewFailed: The review could not be completed.
workspace.applyFailed: The change could not be saved.
workspace.conflict: This review is out of date. Reload the order before trying again.
workspace.policyChanged: The edit policy changed. Reload the order and review it again.

applyError.noResponse: The save request did not return a reason.
applyError.currencyUnresolved: This order has no currency, so the change cannot be saved.
applyError.collectionUnresolved: This order still has a balance, and its settlement type does not say whether that balance must be collected.
applyError.totalChanged: The estimated total is different from the current total. This change is not allowed to change the price.
applyError.reviewNotReady: This review is not ready to save. Review the order again.
applyError.reviewChanged: The order changed after this review. Reload it and review again.
applyError.structurePriceMissing: A new or changed item has no reviewed price, so the change was not saved.

applyError.lineUnsupported: This kind of change cannot be saved yet.
applyError.preferenceParent: A preference was added to a row that is not saved on the order yet.
applyError.versionConflict: Someone else saved this order first. Reload it and review again.
applyError.workflowConflict: This order moved to another workflow step. Reload it and review again.
applyError.idempotencyConflict: This save was already sent with different details. Review the order again.
applyError.idempotencyInFlight: This save is already in progress. Wait, then reload the order.
applyError.removalNotActive: The row to remove is no longer on this order. Reload it and review again.
applyError.updateNotActive: The row to change is no longer on this order. Reload it and review again.
applyError.fieldUpdateLost: The order changed while this save was finishing. Reload it and review again.
applyError.internal: The server could not finish this save.
applyError.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to edit this order.
applyError.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again, then review the order.
